input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Coca-Cola's unit case volume growth in 2025 was driven primarily by its Latin America operating segment. This is an interpretive claim about the primary driver of growth.

Evidence E6 from the 2025 10-K shows the full-year 2025 unit case volume performance by operating segment:
- Worldwide: 0% (even)
- EMEA: 3%
- Latin America: 0% (even)
- North America: -1%
- Asia Pacific: 0% (even)

Since worldwide unit case volume was flat (0%) in 2025, and Latin America was also flat (0%), Latin America could not have been the primary driver of growth. In fact, the only segment showing positive growth was EMEA at 3%. Evidence E3 confirms that "In Latin America, unit case volume was even" for the full year 2025.

The claim is contradicted because Latin America did not drive unit case volume growth in 2025 - it was flat, while EMEA was the only segment with positive growth.
